description: Generate a QR code for a URL, plain text, email, text message or business card (vCard), in a new frame or in an existing frame; giving the frame of an existing QR code edits it (Object > Generate QR Code, Edit QR Code)

color.description: Colour of the code (default Black): A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

data.description: The content. url: url. text: text. email: address, subject, body. sms: number, message. vcard: firstName, lastName, jobTitle, cellPhone, phone, email, organisation, streetAddress, city, state, country, postalCode, website

frameId.description: Put the code in this frame, replacing an existing code (Edit QR Code)

size.description: New frame: width and height in mm (default 30)

x.description: New frame: left edge in mm from the page's left

y.description: New frame: top edge in mm from the page's top

name: create_qr_code
title: Create Qr Code
